sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Designer-Inspired Coin Pendant Necklace - Anti-Tarnish Gold Jewelry
sourceNotes.rawContent:
- Elevate your style with our designer-inspired coin pendant necklace. This chic and modern piece features a circular charm with intricate detailing, exuding luxury without the price tag. Made from anti-tarnish stainless steel and plated in 18K gold, it's a durable and fashionable accessory for any occasion.
-
- Premium Quality | Anti-Tarnish
- Base Material: Stainless Steel
- Plating: 18K Gold-Plated
- Shape: Circular Coin Pendant
- Size: One-size & Adjustable
- Net Quantity: 1
- Designed to complement both casual and formal outfits effortlessly
- Care Tips:
-
- Wipe with a soft cloth after every use
- Avoid contact with harsh chemicals, sprays, and perfumes
- Store in a flat box to prevent scratches
- Do not soak in water
